The '''south ridge of Theed''' was a ridge near [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|principal]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the peaceful [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Widow's Valley]] was nearby, and the [[Naboo airbase]] was located at the ridge during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The south ridge of Theed is a location in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''.
